label: О вас
description: Prepositional sentences that train polite / plural 'about you' after о/обо in real conversation.

missions.phrase: У нас в офисе много говорят о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Being discussed. 'О вас' is the prepositional form of вы after the preposition о, marking you as the topic. The plural 'говорят' reads as an impersonal 'people are talking'.

missions.phrase: Интересно, что они думают о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Others' opinion. 'О вас' is the topic of their thoughts, in the prepositional case after о. The embedded clause shows the construction inside reported thought.

missions.phrase: Мы часто думаем о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Mental focus. 'Думать' takes о plus the prepositional case, so вы becomes 'вас'. The adverb 'часто' adds frequency without touching the pronoun.

missions.phrase: Композитор написал песню о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a work. Here 'о вас' modifies the noun 'песню', naming what the song is about. Prepositional complements with о attach to nouns as well as verbs.

missions.phrase: Скоро выйдет книга о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Subject matter. 'О вас' tells us what the book covers, staying prepositional after о. The construction names a work's subject.

missions.phrase: Все клиенты постоянно спрашивают о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite inquiry. 'Спрашивать о ком-то' uses о plus the prepositional case, so вы appear as 'вас'. This is the everyday way to say people keep asking after you.

missions.phrase: Здесь о вас пока никто не знает.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negative frame. Even under the negation 'никто не знает', 'о вас' keeps its prepositional form. The никто... не pairing is obligatory in Russian.

missions.phrase: В компании все думают о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Broad subject. 'Все' gives a sweeping plural subject, while 'о вас' stays the fixed prepositional object of думать. The locative 'в компании' sets the scene.

missions.phrase: Наша фирма хорошо заботится о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Care for someone. The verb 'заботиться' governs о plus the prepositional case, so вы becomes 'вас'. The adverb 'хорошо' colours how the care is done.

missions.phrase: Они уже всем рассказали о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Past reporting. 'Рассказать о ком-то' keeps о plus the prepositional 'вас'. The past 'рассказали' and dative 'всем' surround the pronoun without changing its case.

missions.phrase: Скоро снимут фильм о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Topic of a film. 'О вас' names what the film is about and modifies the noun 'фильм'. The construction holds for any kind of work.

missions.phrase: Сегодня вышла статья о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Written about you. 'О вас' is the prepositional complement of 'статья', naming its subject. Such phrases fill titles, bios, and the press.

missions.phrase: Они знают о вас слишком много.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Object of knowledge. 'Знать о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional 'вас'. 'Слишком много' adds an everyday evaluation while the pronoun stays fixed.

missions.phrase: В прессе мало говорят о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Quantity of talk. 'О вас' is the topic of 'говорят', held prepositional by о. The quantifier 'мало' measures how much, not the case.

missions.phrase: В городе хорошо говорят о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Positive judgment. 'О вас' stays prepositional after о, while 'хорошо' colours how people speak. A natural way to report a good reputation.

missions.phrase: Мне интересно, что говорят о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dative reaction plus reported speech. 'Мне интересно' frames the feeling with a dative experiencer, and 'что говорят о вас' carries the prepositional pronoun. Two structures combine cleanly.

missions.phrase: Я хорошо помню, что говорили о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Memory of speech. The verb 'помню' opens a clause where 'о вас' stays prepositional after о. Past 'говорили' is an impersonal plural.

missions.phrase: У меня есть пара вопросов о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Noun complement. 'О вас' modifies the noun 'вопросов', naming their subject. The existential 'у меня есть' gives a natural everyday frame.

missions.phrase: Коллеги весь день спорят о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Dispute over a topic. 'Спорить о ком-то' takes о plus the prepositional case, so вы becomes 'вас'. The plural 'спорят' makes it sound like real office life.

missions.phrase: Я не хочу сейчас говорить о вас.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Refusal to discuss. 'О вас' stays prepositional after о despite the chain 'не хочу говорить'. This negated-verb-plus-infinitive stacking is very natural in conversation.
